evidence: timestamp: predict overlaps or precedes train max → within-period pattern
why_generic_validation_is_risky: Random k-fold leaks future observations and ignores group structure. Time holdout ignores within-period overlap. Group k-fold ignores temporal ordering.

recommendation.reason: Prediction period overlaps training AND groups have partial overlap. Use within-period latest-available holdout stratified by group.
recommendation.fit_rule: Train on all but the latest N observations per group per period.
recommendation.validation_rule: Validate on the latest per-group observations.
